prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Adding a custom pet generation status indicator was helpful (+14.7% measured), and the prediction (+14.0%) was slightly too low.
Deferring account sign-in after pet selection significantly harmed performance (-7.3%), and the prediction (+15.0%) was far too high.
Path outcome copy optimization significantly harmed performance (-6.6%), and the prediction (+1.5%) was too high.
Desktop hints and callout overlays showed no clear effect; predictions (+2.5% to +5.0%) were too high.
Home intro redesigns (interactive checklist) and path layout changes (spotlight layout) showed no clear effect, and predictions (+8.0% to +10.0%) were too high.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, wait_info: +14.7% over 1 test(s)
- choose_path, copy: -6.6% over 1 test(s)
- choose_path, layout: -2.0% over 1 test(s)
- finish, hint: +2.1% over 1 test(s)
- finish, redesign: +8.6% over 1 test(s)
- home, hint: +0.7% over 1 test(s)
- sign_in, reorder: -7.3% over 1 test(s)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 72.9%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 68.2%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 20.0%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [home, new_screen] Desktop Spawn Preview Screen: Add a new screen right before home intro that visually previews where and how the pet will first appear on the desktop screen. (why: 3 support emails reported pets not showing on the desktop or the app failing to open during the initial home view step.)
1: [sign_in, reorder] Sign In Account Restoration Notice Layout: Update the sign_in screen to a centered layout with an explicit badge assuring users that existing pets will be automatically restored. (why: 8 support emails (the top bug theme) reported missing or reset pets after signing in again, making sign-in reassurance critical.)
2: [home, wait_info] Waiting Screen Progress Milestones & Tips: Display active render stage timers and helpful tips on the waiting screen while the pet model renders in the background. (why: Home step waiting time is extremely long (mean 2336 seconds / 38 mins), causing significant user drop-off before reaching home_intro.)
3: [choose_path, copy] Story Onboarding Value Proposition Refinement: Rewrite headline and body text on the story screen to clearly explain the desktop pet concept before path selection. (why: Initial path choice drops to 76.2% conversion with a high mean time (514s), showing early user hesitation about what the app offers.)
4: [adoption, new_screen] Pet Temperament & Traits Selection Screen: Introduce a new interactive screen where users pick pet personality traits (playful, calm, energetic) right after choosing a pet. (why: Adoption conversion drops to 68.2%; adding personality customization deepens emotional connection and engagement before adoption certificate generation.)
5: [home, notification] Background Rendering Readiness Alert Toggle: Enable background notification toggling on the waiting screen so users get notified when their pet is ready to spawn. (why: Mean wait time during home step is over 38 minutes (2336s), causing users to close or ignore the app while waiting.)

scores.note: Adding a new screen increases friction and cost; past new screen/redesign attempts yielded minimal results.
Strong support mail evidence (top bug theme), but past sign_in layout/reorder changes performed poorly (-7.3%).
Proven success with wait_info updates (+14.7%) targeting the massive 38-minute home wait time.
Low cost, but choose_path copy changes previously resulted in a -6.6% drop in conversion.
High cost and adds extra step friction prior to adoption; extra screens tend to hurt funnel flow.
Directly tackles the extreme home wait time (2336s) by allowing users to leave and return when ready.
